I just landed on Ventnor Avenue in the yellow group for $260. I don't own any yellows yet, but my real focus is building pink—I need Virginia to complete it. Buying Ventnor would block opponents and give me leverage, and I have enough cash ($1320) to afford it without straining my position. Still, it's a distraction from my core strategy, so I'm weighing whether the defensive value outweighs the opportunity cost of not staying focused on pink.

Actually, yellow is worth pursuing too since all three properties are still available. With $1060 left after buying Ventnor, I can still grab Virginia for $160 and have $900 to start building houses on pink—that's enough for a few houses on each property. The math works out, and securing a foothold in yellow now prevents others from doing the same. I'm going to buy it.
